title: SyncroBrain telemetry envelope
description: Published Pack/Gateway telemetry envelope (schemaVersion telemetry-envelope/1.0). Device production MQTT remains ThingsBoard flat keys; quality coexists as companion *_quality string keys. Distinct from alarm mapping quality ok|unmapped.

type.description: Optional Pack channel key used when flattening to TB (e.g. temperature)

quality.description: Telemetry point quality (not alarm mapping quality)
